DataMode.description:
Argo and oceanographic data processing mode.
R: Real-Time mode (immediate transmission, automated QC only).
A: Real-Time Adjusted mode (real-time data with sensor drift correction or automated adjustment applied).
D: Delayed-Mode (expert scientific validation, rigorous calibration against climatology/reference data).
DataMode.title: DataMode

derivation_method_version.description: Version/name of the QC evaluation algorithm.
derivation_method_version.title: Derivation Method Version

is_fully_certified.description: True if position, time, and all primary variables have passed quality standards.
is_fully_certified.title: Is Fully Certified

qartod_tests_executed.description: List of specific QARTOD or Argo automated tests executed (e.g. 'syntax_check', 'gross_range_test', 'spike_test', 'density_inversion_test').

qc_derivation_source.description: Provenance of the QC evaluation: provider-supplied or locally derived by QuasarOS.

PlatformType.description: Taxonomy of ocean observation platform types.

ProfileQCGrade.description: Overall profile quality grade (e.g. Argo profile-level flag 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F').
ProfileQCGrade.title: ProfileQCGrade

ProfileVariableEntry.description:
Metadata describing an individual variable measured along a vertical profile,
explicitly distinguishing raw vs adjusted variable references and units.

adjusted_variable_name.description: Adjusted variable name in source file if available (e.g. 'TEMP_ADJUSTED', 'PSAL_ADJUSTED').
adjusted_variable_name.title: Adjusted Variable Name

data_mode.description: Data mode applied to this specific variable ('R', 'A', 'D').

error_variable_name.description: Error/uncertainty variable name in source file (e.g. 'TEMP_ADJUSTED_ERROR').
error_variable_name.title: Error Variable Name

has_adjusted_values.description: Whether adjusted values are present and should be preferred over raw data.
has_adjusted_values.title: Has Adjusted Values

qc_variable_name.description: QC flag variable name in source file (e.g. 'TEMP_QC', 'TEMP_ADJUSTED_QC').
qc_variable_name.title: Qc Variable Name

raw_variable_name.description: Raw variable name in source file (e.g. 'TEMP', 'PSAL', 'DOXY').
raw_variable_name.title: Raw Variable Name

QCDerivationSource.description: Source of the quality control flags and evaluation.

VariableQCRecord.description:
Quality control record for a single variable along a vertical profile or trajectory segment.
Stores raw integer QC flags, normalized QC states, and statistical summary.

derivation_method_version.description: Version/identifier of the QC derivation pipeline or algorithm applied (e.g. 'Argo-QC-Manual-v3.4', 'Quasar-QARTOD-v1.0.0').
derivation_method_version.title: Derivation Method Version

good_levels_count.description: Number of levels classified as good / probably_good.
good_levels_count.title: Good Levels Count

is_valid_for_collocation.description: Whether this variable profile meets QC thresholds to be collocated with model fields.
is_valid_for_collocation.title: Is Valid For Collocation

level_qc_flags.description: Per-level raw integer QC flags along the vertical axis.
level_qc_flags.title: Level Qc Flags

profile_qc_flag.description: Profile-level aggregate QC flag for this specific variable (e.g. WMO Argo 1=good, 4=bad).
profile_qc_flag.title: Profile Qc Flag

qc_derivation_source.description: Provenance of the QC flags: provider-supplied or locally derived by QuasarOS.

description:
Authoritative scientific contract for an individual vertical observation cast / profile.
Captures platform identity, cycle index, spatio-temporal coordinates, direction,
data modes, raw/adjusted variable references, and QC report.

cycle_number.description: Observation cycle number / cast index (0-indexed or 1-indexed according to provider).
cycle_number.title: Cycle Number

is_bgc.description: True if this cast contains Biogeochemical (BGC) variables (e.g. DOXY, CHLA, NITRATE, BBP700, PH_IN_SITU_TOTAL).
is_bgc.title: Is Bgc

level_count.description: Number of vertical levels sampled in the profile.
level_count.title: Level Count

max_depth_m.description: Maximum physical depth reached in meters.
max_depth_m.title: Max Depth M

observation_time_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of profile observation.
observation_time_utc.title: Observation Time Utc

profile_id.description: Unique identifier for this profile cast (e.g. 'incois_argo_7902250_cycle_042_A').
profile_id.title: Profile Id

qc_report.description: Structured quality control report for this profile cast.

variables.description: Dictionary of measured variables keyed by canonical variable id.
variables.title: Variables
